stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 20 m by 25 m is surrounded by a path 2 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $24$ m by $29$ m, an area of $696$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $500$ square m leaves $196$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
